# betaSandwich

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan 2026-06-11

## Description

Generates robust confidence intervals for standardized regression
coefficients using heteroskedasticity-consistent standard errors for
models fitted by [`lm()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/lm.html) as described
in Dudgeon (2017: <http://doi.org/10.1007/s11336-017-9563-z>). The
package can also be used to generate confidence intervals for R-squared,
adjusted R-squared, and differences of standardized regression
coefficients. A description of the package and code examples are
presented in Pesigan, Sun, and Cheung (2023:
<https://doi.org/10.1080/00273171.2023.2201277>).

## Installation

You can install the CRAN release of `betaSandwich` with:

``` r

install.packages("betaSandwich")
```

You can install the development version of `betaSandwich` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich) with:

``` r

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("jeksterslab/betaSandwich")
```

## Example

In this example, a multiple regression model is fitted using program
quality ratings (`QUALITY`) as the regressand/outcome variable and
number of published articles attributed to the program faculty members
(`NARTIC`), percent of faculty members holding research grants
(`PCTGRT`), and percentage of program graduates who received support
(`PCTSUPP`) as regressor/predictor variables using a data set from 1982
ratings of 46 doctoral programs in psychology in the USA (National
Research Council, 1982). Robust confidence intervals for the
standardized regression coefficients are generated using the
[`BetaHC()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/BetaHC.md)
function from the `betaSandwich` package following Dudgeon (2017).

``` r

library(betaSandwich)
```

``` r

df <- betaSandwich::nas1982
```

### Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.

``` r

object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Estimate the standardized regression slopes and the corresponding robust sampling covariance matrix.

``` r

BetaHC(object, type = "hc3", alpha = 0.05)
#> Call:
#> BetaHC(object = object, type = "hc3", alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Standardized regression slopes with HC3 standard errors:
#>            est     se      t df      p   2.5%  97.5%
#> NARTIC  0.4951 0.0786 6.3025 42 0.0000 0.3366 0.6537
#> PCTGRT  0.3915 0.0818 4.7831 42 0.0000 0.2263 0.5567
#> PCTSUPP 0.2632 0.0855 3.0786 42 0.0037 0.0907 0.4358
```

## Other Features

The package can also be used to generate confidence intervals for
R-squared, adjusted R-squared, and differences of standardized
regression coefficients.

## Documentation

See [GitHub
Pages](https://jeksterslab.github.io/betaSandwich/index.html) for
package documentation.

## Citation

To cite `betaSandwich` in publications, please cite Pesigan et al.
(2023).

## References

Dudgeon, P. (2017). Some improvements in confidence intervals for
standardized regression coefficients. *Psychometrika*, *82*(4), 928–951.
<https://doi.org/10.1007/s11336-017-9563-z>

National Research Council. (1982). *An assessment of research-doctorate
programs in the United States: Social and behavioral sciences*. National
Academies Press. <https://doi.org/10.17226/9781>

Pesigan, I. J. A., Sun, R. W., & Cheung, S. F. (2023). betaDelta and
betaSandwich: Confidence intervals for standardized regression
coefficients in R. *Multivariate Behavioral Research*, *58*(6),
1183–1186. <https://doi.org/10.1080/00273171.2023.2201277>

R Core Team. (2026). *R: A language and environment for statistical
computing*. R Foundation for Statistical Computing.
<https://www.R-project.org/>

# Package index

## Standardized Regression Coefficients

- [`BetaADF()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/BetaADF.md)
  : Estimate Standardized Regression Coefficients and the Corresponding
  Sampling Covariance Matrix Using the Asymptotic Distribution-Free
  Approach
- [`BetaHC()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/BetaHC.md)
  : Estimate Standardized Regression Coefficients and the Corresponding
  Robust Sampling Covariance Matrix Using the Heteroskedasticity
  Consistent Approach
- [`BetaN()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/BetaN.md)
  : Estimate Standardized Regression Coefficients and the Corresponding
  Sampling Covariance Matrix Assuming Multivariate Normality

## Multiple Correlation

- [`RSqBetaSandwich()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/RSqBetaSandwich.md)
  : Estimate Multiple Correlation Coefficients (R-squared and adjusted
  R-squared) and the Corresponding Sampling Covariance Matrix

## Differences of Standardized Regression Coefficients

- [`DiffBetaSandwich()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/DiffBetaSandwich.md)
  : Estimate Differences of Standardized Slopes and the Corresponding
  Sampling Covariance Matrix

## Methods

- [`coef(`*`<betasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/coef.betasandwich.md)
  : Standardized Regression Slopes

- [`coef(`*`<diffbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/coef.diffbetasandwich.md)
  : Differences of Standardized Regression Slopes

- [`coef(`*`<rsqbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/coef.rsqbetasandwich.md)
  : Multiple Correlation Coefficients (R-Squared and Adjusted R-Squared)

- [`confint(`*`<betasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/confint.betasandwich.md)
  : Confidence Intervals for Standardized Regression Slopes

- [`confint(`*`<diffbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/confint.diffbetasandwich.md)
  : Confidence Intervals for Differences of Standardized Regression
  Slopes

- [`confint(`*`<rsqbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/confint.rsqbetasandwich.md)
  : Confidence Intervals for Multiple Correlation Coefficients
  (R-Squared and Adjusted R-Squared)

- [`print(`*`<betasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/print.betasandwich.md)
  :

  Print Method for an Object of Class `betasandwich`

- [`print(`*`<diffbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/print.diffbetasandwich.md)
  :

  Print Method for an Object of Class `diffbetasandwich`

- [`print(`*`<rsqbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/print.rsqbetasandwich.md)
  :

  Print Method for an Object of Class `rsqbetasandwich`

- [`summary(`*`<betasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/summary.betasandwich.md)
  :

  Summary Method for an Object of Class `betasandwich`

- [`summary(`*`<diffbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/summary.diffbetasandwich.md)
  :

  Summary Method for an Object of Class `diffbetasandwich`

- [`summary(`*`<rsqbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/summary.rsqbetasandwich.md)
  :

  Summary Method for an Object of Class `rsqbetasandwich`

- [`vcov(`*`<betasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/vcov.betasandwich.md)
  : Sampling Covariance Matrix of the Standardized Regression Slopes

- [`vcov(`*`<diffbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/vcov.diffbetasandwich.md)
  : Sampling Covariance Matrix of Differences of Standardized Regression
  Slopes

- [`vcov(`*`<rsqbetasandwich>`*`)`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/vcov.rsqbetasandwich.md)
  : Sampling Covariance Matrix of Multiple Correlation Coefficients
  (R-Squared and Adjusted R-Squared)

## Data

- [`nas1982`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/betaSandwich/reference/nas1982.md)
  : 1982 National Academy of Sciences Doctoral Programs Data
